text:
Waaaah!?
Eeeeek!?
Eeeeek!?
Huh...?
Wh-what's your problem...?
You don't have
to yell...
I'm sorry...
I meant no harm.
Wh-what are you doing!?
That was dangerous!
Oh, um...
W-well...
▲!?
Why are you...?
▲!?
Why...?
▲!?
Why...?
Someone asked me
to come get you,
Teacher...
I was asked
to come get you.
Someone asked me
to come get you!
Th-they asked me
to come and
get you, Teacher...
Me?
Me?
Everyone's meeting at the spring...
Something about
an emergency meeting...
Please go to the spring.
There's a meeting.
Everyone's meeting at the spring...
Apparently there's something
that needs urgent discussion...
We're to gather at the spring.
Apparently there's something urgent
to discuss...
Hey, Kyuuma!
It seems...
that's indeed the case.
Anyway, let's hurry!
Anyway,
let's go!
What happened?
What happened?
A FIRE...
A fire...
You mean there's a fire!?
A fire...
You mean there's a fire!?
Then we have to hurry
and put it out!
Easy there.
We already
put it out.
Oh...
Huh... Oh...
Ooh...
But it doesn't
appear to have
started naturally.
But however you look at it,
there's a lot that's suspicious.
Huh?
Looks like someone
set it deliberately.
So the first thing to burn
was the pile of straw
stacked here...
So the first thing to burn
was the pile of straw
stacked here...
The children playing nearby
were the first to notice.
Then it was our village.
